scope: Completed ranker validation evidence and selected full-data checkpoints for the draft ranker PR.
inclusion_policy: Each selected MLP/DIN run includes its seven standard checkpoint/record files.
Other completed MLP ladder/repetition runs include the six standard record files excluding model.pt.
Completed analysis roots include reports, figures, numeric summaries, source snapshots/hash manifests, compact rank archives and raw timing artifacts, subject to the exclusions below.
Only the K1 sweep validation_groups.parquet is shared; diagnostics reads it together with seed0_ranks.npz, seed1_ranks.npz and seed2_ranks.npz.
Historical source snapshots and experiment provenance files retain their original bytes.
exclusion_policy: Every artifact outside this explicit allowlist, including other sample/development, invalid, aborted and superseded ranker runs.
Every *.log and every file inside any .mpl-cache directory.
Redundant validation_groups.parquet in ranker_repeat/20261024-shortlist-repeat, ranker_din_study/20261024-din-matching and ranker_comparison/20261025-rq3.
Nonselected MLP model.pt checkpoints; six selected full-data MLP/DIN checkpoints are shared.
ranker_diagnostics/20261025-score-diagnostic/cohort_scores.npz, demotion_events.csv and query_correlations.csv remain local and regenerable.
Raw/processed datasets, candidate lists, text embeddings and other caches under data/ remain external prerequisites.
This sharing manifest does not list itself.

presentation_updates.note: Added interpretation banner; original report preserved as report_historical.md. Numerical artifacts and historical figures unchanged.
